articles.title: "Resolve is to make India developed by 2047, build world's most powerful Air Force through self-reliance": MoS Defence Sanjay Seth
articles.summary: Union Minister of State for Defence Sanjay Seth reaffirmed the government's commitment to building a self-reliant defence ecosystem. He stressed the strategic aim of making India a developed nation through indigenous defence capabilities. This initiative, aligning with the 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' vision, seeks to enhance national security, foster economic growth, and strengthen India's global position. It underscores a focus on domestic innovation and production.

articles.title: India Germany to sign the Rs 90,000 crore submarine deal for Indian Navy soon ,says German envoy Philipp Ackermann
articles.summary: India and Germany are nearing the finalisation of the long-awaited Project-75I submarine agreement, a crucial defence deal for the Indian Navy. German Ambassador Philipp Ackermann expressed confidence in the pact being signed soon. This strategic acquisition is vital for modernizing India's submarine fleet, enhancing underwater capabilities, and bolstering the nation's maritime security in the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: India, Germany likely to sign ₹90,000 crore submarine deal soon: German envoy
